title: Pre-Strings Lectures on Artificial Intelligence
summary: These notes are based on six lectures given over three days at the Pre-Strings 2026 school in Shanghai. Day 1 develops neural network essentials, organized around the expressivity, statistics, and dynamics of neural networks, presented with a field-theoretic lens. Day 2 develops a neural network approach to field theory (NN-FT), in which a field theory is defined by a network architecture and a density on its parameters, and surveys recent results.
